name: Animated Content
description: Scroll-triggered wrapper that slides, blurs, tilts or wipes content and its children into view.
tasteNote: Safe default for section entrances; keep travel small and durations under 600ms.

name: Blob Cursor
description: Liquid-metal 3D blob replaces the cursor, stretching with movement and splashing into droplets on click.
tasteNote: Custom cursors cost usability; keep to portfolios or playful brand pages, never dashboards.

name: Click Spark
description: Emits a small burst of sparks, dots or stars from every click point.
tasteNote: Scope it to one celebratory button rather than the whole page.

name: Crosshair
description: Crosshair cursor with live coordinates that snaps to and measures links and buttons.
tasteNote: Fits engineering or design-tool brands; reads as noise elsewhere.

name: Cubes
description: Grid of outlined 3D cubes that turn toward the pointer and ripple on click.

name: Electric Border
description: Crackling current wraps an element's border and sparks toward the cursor.
tasteNote: Loud by design; one highlighted card or pricing tier at most.

name: Fade Content
description: Scroll wrapper fading content in from blur, grayscale, grain, mist or pixel blocks.
tasteNote: The plain fade is the tasteful choice; exotic variants suit editorial pages.

name: Glare Hover
description: Glossy light streak sweeps across an element in the pointer's direction.
tasteNote: Subtle on product cards; skip on text-heavy blocks.

name: Gradual Blur
description: Progressive edge blur for headers, footers and scroll areas, optionally fading to a color.
tasteNote: Quietly premium; great for sticky headers and carousel edges.

name: Crystalized Ball
description: Glass orb with a crackling electric rim and glowing dust swirling with the cursor.
tasteNote: Works as an AI assistant avatar or single hero focal point.

name: Electric Logo
description: Animates a logo outline as live lightning with arcs jumping off its edges.

name: Dither Veil
description: A 1-bit dithered photo that the cursor burns through to reveal full color.

name: Glow Cursor
description: Soft light pours from the cursor, drifting and cooling as it fades.

name: Ghost Cursor
description: Glowing smoke ghost follows the pointer and curls away as it rises.
tasteNote: Novelty for game or seasonal sites, not product UI.

name: Image Trail
description: Spawns a trail of images behind the moving cursor, with several variants.
tasteNote: Classic agency-portfolio move; only earns its place with strong photography.

name: Logo Loop
description: Seamless infinite marquee of brand or tech logos that pauses on hover.
tasteNote: Tasteful logo rail; keep logos monochrome and the speed slow.

name: Magnet
description: Wrapper that pulls an element toward the cursor and springs it back.
tasteNote: Low strength on a CTA feels premium; strong pulls feel broken.

name: Meta Balls
description: Liquid metaballs that merge and split, with a cursor blob pushing through them.

name: Strands
description: Spectral strands twist inside a frosted glass orb, like a voice assistant.
tasteNote: Ideal for AI or voice listening states; pointless as decoration.

name: Metallic Paint
description: Flowing liquid-chrome shader applied over a logo or text shape.

name: Noise
description: Film grain overlay ranging from fine 35mm grain to dust, paper and static.
tasteNote: Barely visible grain adds warmth to flat gradients; keep opacity low.

name: Pixel Trail
description: Glossy pixels melt into a gooey trail behind the cursor.

name: Pixel Transition
description: Retro pixel dissolve covers a card, swaps the content beneath, then clears.

name: Pixel Swap
description: New content builds in pixel by pixel in a springy wave from the cursor's entry point.

name: Ribbons
description: Springy ribbon trails follow the cursor in several shapes.

name: Shape Blur
description: A crisp logo or shape drifts out of focus under the pointer like a lens.

name: Splash Cursor
description: Fluid simulation trails the cursor in swirling ink and splashes on click.
tasteNote: Heavy and distracting; avoid anywhere people need to read.

name: Star Border
description: A twinkling star travels the outline of a button or card, trailing light.
tasteNote: Nice on a single primary CTA; slow it down.

name: Sticker Peel
description: Die-cut sticker you can peel, drag and throw, in gloss, matte or holographic.

name: Target Cursor
description: Reticle cursor whose corner brackets snap around hovered targets.

name: Laser Flow
description: A beam of light splashes onto content and pours over its corners.

name: Antigravity
description: Particle field lifting into a glowing ring around the cursor, bursting on click.

name: Orbit Images
description: Images orbit along a customizable SVG path.

name: ASCII Text
description: Waving ASCII-rendered text that tilts toward the pointer and scrambles on hover.

name: Blur Text
description: Text resolves from blurred to sharp for a soft-focus entrance.
tasteNote: One of the most tasteful heading entrances; keep it quick.

name: Circular Text
description: Arranges characters around a circle with optional spinning.

name: Count Up
description: Animated counter rising to a value, with formatting and decimals.
tasteNote: Good for stat rows; trigger once when scrolled into view.

name: Curved Loop
description: Looping text flowing along a custom curve that you can drag.

name: Decrypted Text
description: Cycles random glyphs before resolving into the real text.
tasteNote: Fine for dev-tool or security brands; turns cliche fast.

name: Falling Text
description: Text breaks into physics-driven letters that pile up and can be thrown.

name: Fuzzy Text
description: Vibrating fuzzy text whose intensity responds to hover.
tasteNote: Fun on 404 pages, wrong for headlines that must be read.

name: Glitch Text
description: RGB-split glitch distortion with jitter on text.

name: Gradient Text
description: Animated gradient inside text: sliding sweep, drifting mesh or conic fan.
tasteNote: Use on one or two words, not whole headlines.

name: Rotating Text
description: Cycles through phrases with 3D flip or rotate transitions.
tasteNote: Classic hero swap pattern; three to five short words.

name: Scrambled Text
description: Characters near the cursor scramble and distort.

name: Scroll Float
description: Letters float and shift with scroll for a parallax heading reveal.

name: Scroll Reveal
description: Text unblurs and fades in progressively as you scroll.
tasteNote: Good for one manifesto paragraph; never on body copy.

name: Scroll Velocity
description: Text marquee whose speed and skew follow scroll velocity.

name: Shiny Text
description: A sheen of light sweeps across text, from soft bands to chrome reflections.
tasteNote: Subtle on small eyebrow labels or badges; tacky on long text.

name: Split Text
description: Splits text into characters, words or lines for a staggered entrance.
tasteNote: Best default hero headline entrance; animate words or lines for long text.

name: Text Cursor
description: Stamps copies of text or emoji trailing the cursor.

name: Text Pressure
description: Variable-font letters stretch and gain weight based on pointer proximity.

name: Text Type
description: Typewriter effect with blinking caret and adjustable typing cadence.
tasteNote: Keep it to one line; never make users wait to read the CTA.

name: True Focus
description: Steps a sharp focus frame through words while blurring the rest.

name: Variable Proximity
description: Letters vary font weight continuously with pointer distance.

name: Shuffle
description: Characters shuffle like a slot machine before settling into the text.

name: Particle Text
description: Text assembles from drifting particles that can scatter and reform.

name: Split Flap Text
description: Mechanical split-flap board clacking between phrases.
tasteNote: Great for travel, transit or time-based content.

name: Warp Text
description: WebGL warp bending and refracting text around the pointer.

name: Tech Text
description: Wordmark letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor.

name: Stroke Text
description: Outlined letterforms draw themselves on, then flood with fill.

name: Depth Text
description: Layered extruded type that parallaxes against the pointer.

name: Fold Text
description: Lines unfold into place like creased paper opening flat.

name: Echo Text
description: Ghost copies trail behind text and converge into a single word.

name: Masked Heading
description: Headline with a drifting color mesh or image showing through, revealed word by word.
tasteNote: Editorial and premium for a single hero headline.

name: Text Loop
description: Seamless text marquee flowing along curved SVG paths.

name: Animated List
description: Scrolling list with rows springing in, gliding selection and keyboard support.

name: Bounce Cards
description: Fan of photo cards that bounce in and spread apart on hover.

name: Bubble Menu
description: Floating circular menu that expands into staggered bubble items.

name: Card Nav
description: Navigation bar that springs open into a row of link cards.

name: Card Swap
description: 3D card stack that sends the front card to the back on a timer or fling.
tasteNote: Good feature showcase beside a hero; keep three to five cards.

name: Carousel
description: Swipeable card carousel with five transitions and an autoplay timer.

name: Chroma Grid
description: Grayscale photo cards where a cursor spotlight brings back color.
tasteNote: Nice team or portfolio grid; needs consistent photography.

name: Holo Card
description: Trading card with holographic foil and glitter that shimmers as it tilts.

name: Circular Carousel
description: 3D ring of bendable image cards with momentum drag and snapping.

name: Flex Carousel
description: Infinite image row flowing through liquid glass at its edges.

name: Depth Carousel
description: Cards recede along a 3D rail with drag, keyboard and auto-advance.

name: Accordion Gallery
description: Panels expand on hover or focus to reveal parallax images and captions.

name: Morph Slider
description: WebGL image slider melting between slides with a displacement transition.

name: Drift Wall
description: Endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past and lifting on hover.

name: Circular Gallery
description: Curved draggable image gallery whose cards open to the full image.

name: Counter
description: Odometer-style rolling digits with currency, separators and locales.
tasteNote: Tasteful for prices and live metrics.

name: Decay Card
description: Image card that tears and melts as the pointer moves, then reforms.

name: Dock
description: macOS-style dock with magnification, launch bounce, badges and context menus.
tasteNote: Fits app-like portfolios; poor as primary site navigation.

name: Dome Gallery
description: Images projected onto an immersive draggable 3D dome.

name: Elastic Slider
description: Range slider that swells under the cursor and stretches past its ends.

name: Flowing Menu
description: Full-height menu where a liquid band glides between rows revealing marquees.
tasteNote: Agency-style full-screen nav; overkill for apps.

name: Fluid Glass
description: 3D glass object refracting your headline or media and morphing between shapes.

name: Flying Posters
description: 3D posters twist and flip through an endless scroll column.

name: Folder
description: Folder that opens its flap or swings like a book, with pages you can pick.

name: Glass Icons
description: Liquid-glass icon tiles that bend the color behind them.

name: Glass Surface
description: Apple-style liquid glass panel refracting whatever sits behind it.
tasteNote: Use for a floating nav or toolbar over imagery; check text contrast.

name: Gooey Nav
description: Nav bar whose active pill flows like goo to the selected item.

name: Infinite Spiral
description: Endlessly looping 3D helix of images.

name: Infinite Menu
description: Draggable sphere of image tiles that snaps the nearest forward with its title.

name: Lanyard
description: Swinging 3D badge on a stretchy lanyard you can drag, throw and flip.
tasteNote: Memorable on event or about pages; heavy three.js payload.

name: Magic Bento
description: Bento grid of feature cards with live artwork, cursor edge light and click waves.
tasteNote: Strong feature section; tone the glow down so content leads.

name: Masonry
description: Responsive masonry gallery that springs in, reflows and opens a lightbox.

name: Model Viewer
description: Self-framing 3D model viewer floating over a soft shadow.

name: Pill Nav
description: Pill navigation where a fill rises through hovered links and an active dot slides.

name: Pixel Card
description: Card that fills with twinkling pixels on hover, from the center or cursor.

name: Profile Card
description: Framed profile card tilting toward the cursor with holographic foil.

name: Scroll Stack
description: Cards pin and stack as you scroll, settling into a dimmed deck.
tasteNote: Great for step-by-step feature stories; keep the deck short.

name: Spotlight Card
description: Card with a soft pointer-following spotlight that also reaches nearby cards.
tasteNote: Subtle and tasteful on dark feature grids.

name: Border Glow
description: Mesh-gradient border glow that follows cursor direction and brightens near edges.

name: Line Sidebar
description: List navigation whose items shift and highlight by cursor proximity.

name: Option Wheel
description: Curved picker wheel that spins with scroll, drag or arrow keys.

name: Specular Button
description: Glass button with a specular edge highlight that glides toward the cursor.

name: Elastic Mesh
description: Turns text or a logo into a puffy inflated shape you can poke and stretch.

name: Ripple Distortion
description: Pointer-driven water displacement warps content and leaves a fading wake.

name: Swarm Cursor
description: Particle swarm flows after the cursor and curls around hovered buttons.

name: Halftone Reveal
description: Halftone print of an image whose dots swell into the real photo under the cursor.
tasteNote: Editorial and tasteful on hero imagery.

name: Scroll Expand
description: Rounded media frame grows to full bleed as it scrolls through the viewport.
tasteNote: Strong for a product video reveal; one per page.

name: Cursor Grid
description: Grid cells light up and fade behind the cursor, with click pulses.

name: Curved Input
description: Arc-shaped input whose text, caret and submit button follow the curve.

name: Stack
description: Draggable card pile you flick through, with thrown cards tucking underneath.

name: Stepper
description: Multi-step flow with a gliding step indicator and spring transitions.

name: Tilted Card
description: 3D card tilting toward the cursor with glare, shadow, floating layers and a flip side.

name: Staggered Menu
description: Menu whose items animate in with a stagger on open and close.

name: Reflective Card
description: Metal ID card reflecting the camera or a video and catching light as it tilts.
tasteNote: Webcam mode needs consent; the video mode is the safer default.

name: Pattern Waves
description: Lit halftone surface of dots, lines or glyphs rippling like draped silk.

name: Micro Slats
description: Wall of tiny slats rolling like a sea in perspective, with glinting crests.

name: Shape Waves
description: Field of geometric shapes brightening and growing along rolling waves.

name: Aero Shards
description: Glass shard ribbons streaming through layered depth, catching light on their edges.

name: Ghost Fibers
description: Glowing fiber ribbons twist and drift with soft depth of field.

name: Aurora
description: Calm aurora gradient flowing across the top of the page toward the cursor.
tasteNote: Among the most tasteful hero backgrounds; keep colors near the brand palette.

name: Balatro
description: Swirling pixelated paint shader inspired by Balatro, stirred by cursor and clicks.
tasteNote: Game and playful brands only.

name: Ballpit
description: Physics ball pit you can shove, grab, throw and blast apart.

name: Beams
description: Glossy light ribbons rippling in the dark, lit by a cursor-following light.

name: Color Bends
description: Vivid flowing color bands bending smoothly across the surface.

name: CRT Warp
description: Blocky plasma on a curved CRT with scanlines, phosphor mask and power-on intro.

name: Dark Veil
description: Silky veil of light drifting in darkness and bending around the cursor.
tasteNote: Moody and restrained; good behind white headline text.

name: Dither
description: Retro dithered waves with Bayer, halftone, line and noise patterns plus cursor trails.

name: Dot Field
description: Gradient dot field seen through a cursor lens that magnifies, pinches or swirls.

name: Dot Grid
description: Springy dot grid that the cursor drags through like jelly, with click shockwaves.
tasteNote: Low-key interactive texture that does not fight content.

name: Faulty Terminal
description: Flickering CRT terminal of glowing glyphs with phosphor trails and click glitches.

name: Galaxy
description: Endless flight through a twinkling starfield with warp jumps.

name: Gradient Blinds
description: Satin gradient blinds that sway and turn toward a cursor spotlight.

name: Lightfall
description: Light streaks fall down a curved tunnel and stretch into warp trails on hold.

name: Flux Lines
description: Glowing flux lines trace a churning magnetic fluid that the cursor curls.

name: Ferrofluid
description: Glossy magnetic fluid with rolling spike swells and a cursor-raised crown.

name: Molten Metal
description: Swirling caustic filaments with white-hot cores that heat up under the cursor.

name: Gradient Waves
description: Lit satin waves roll in from a hazy horizon toward a cursor light.

name: Web Threads
description: Glowing threads woven through luminous pinch points that react to the cursor.

name: Topography
description: 3D landscape of glowing contour lines rising under the cursor.
tasteNote: Fits data, outdoor or mapping products; elegant at low contrast.

name: Light Tunnel
description: Fibre-optic tunnel with comets of light racing into depth.

name: Sliced Waves
description: Waves of colored light sliced into glowing bars, with a cursor-following focus.

name: Acid Squares
description: Rolling field of glossy squares under two drifting colored lights.

name: Scanner
description: Interference lines swept by a scan beam, with CRT finish and click pings.

name: Gradient ASCII
description: Soft gradient glows drawn in ASCII characters that scramble near the cursor.

name: Grainient
description: Flowing grainy gradient you can stir with the cursor.
tasteNote: Warm and modern hero backdrop when colors stay muted.

name: Grid Scan
description: 3D grid room swept by a scanning light that follows your view.

name: Grid Distortion
description: Image background that breaks into displaced grid blocks under the cursor.

name: Grid Motion
description: Tilted wall of drifting tiles sliding with the pointer.

name: Hyperspeed
description: Night highway of glowing light trails that warps into hyperspace on hold.
tasteNote: Spectacle with a heavy three.js scene; best for launch or event pages.

name: Iridescence
description: Liquid iridescent surface with shifting folds you can stir.

name: Letter Glitch
description: Field of colored letters that flicker and scramble, torn apart by clicks.

name: Light Rays
description: Volumetric light rays from any edge, steered by the cursor.
tasteNote: Soft top-down rays frame a hero well; keep intensity low.

name: Lightning
description: Branching lightning that bends toward the cursor and strikes on click.

name: Line Waves
description: Fine lines flowing in silky waves with a drifting band of light.
tasteNote: Minimal and elegant on light or dark themes.

name: Evil Eye
description: Procedural eye shader with animated iris, slit pupil and fiery glow.
tasteNote: Niche novelty; not listed in the site sidebar.

name: Radar
description: Radar scope whose sweep leaves phosphor afterglow and picks up contacts.

name: Soft Aurora
description: Soft aurora borealis shader built on 3D noise and cosine palettes.

name: Magic Rings
description: Glowing rings pulse outward and swell toward the cursor.

name: Liquid Chrome
description: Liquid chrome ribbons swirl in a dark pool and ripple under the cursor.

name: Orb
description: Breathing ring of swirling color with an orbiting light that reaches for the cursor.
tasteNote: Classic AI-product hero orb; center it behind minimal text.

name: Particles
description: Drifting 3D particle field with glow, twinkle and constellation lines.

name: Pixel Blast
description: Dithered pixel clouds that shimmer under the cursor, with ripples and a floor.

name: Plasma
description: Satin folds of light twisting slowly in the dark toward the cursor.

name: Plasma Wave
description: Two curling plasma ribbons with soft glow and white-hot cores.

name: Prism
description: Rotating prism of glowing spectral light with configurable shape and colors.

name: Prismatic Burst
description: Prismatic light rays lean toward the cursor and pulse outward on click.

name: Ripple Grid
description: Grid lines ripple like water and light up as waves pass.

name: Silk
description: Flowing glossy satin folds that turn toward the cursor.
tasteNote: Luxurious and calm; suits fashion or premium brands.

name: Side Rays
description: Shafts of light fan in from a corner or side and shimmer slowly.

name: Shape Grid
description: Drifting grid of shapes that lights up under the cursor with rainbow trails.

name: Threads
description: Flowing threads that fray and part around the cursor.

name: Waves
description: Dense flowing lines sway like silk and bend around the cursor.

name: Magnet Lines
description: Grid of line segments that swing toward the cursor like compass needles.

name: Liquid Ether
description: Glowing fluid swirling under the cursor, colored by flow speed.

name: Floating Lines
description: Ribbons of fine glowing lines drift in waves and part around the cursor.

name: Light Pillar
description: Swirling pillar of light that ignites on load and surges on click.

name: Pixel Snow
description: Layered pixel-art snowflakes drifting down, brushed aside by the cursor.

name: Squish Switch
description: Toggle whose thumb stretches with speed and squashes against the ends.

name: Hold Button
description: Hold-to-confirm button with a rising liquid fill that resets if released.
tasteNote: Right pattern for destructive actions; pair with a text hint.

name: Peek Rating
description: Star rating where stars lift toward the pointer and pop on commit.

name: Spring Check
description: Checkbox row that fills, draws a tick and strikes the label on one spring.

name: Pulse Heart
description: Like button that contracts, flips color and pulses as the count ticks.

name: Rubber Segment
description: Segmented control with a rubbery thumb stretching between options.

name: Slide Commit
description: Slide-to-confirm handle that spins while working and becomes a done pill.

name: Warm Tooltip
description: Tooltip group that delays the first tip, then opens siblings instantly.
tasteNote: Pure UX polish; invisible when done right, always tasteful.

name: Fuse Button
description: Action button whose done state offers undo on a burning fuse timer.

name: Scrub Field
description: Number chip you drag to scrub, with rubber-band limits and click to type.

name: Lattice Loader
description: Agent status row with a lattice of pulsing cells beside a live stopwatch.

name: Dodge Field
description: Wrapper that makes a child dodge the pointer before gliding home.

name: Code Slots
description: One-time code input with springing digits, paste and SMS autofill.
tasteNote: Delightful on auth flows; never sacrifice paste or autofill.

name: Wake Slider
description: Thumbless slider of thin bars where drag speed raises a wake.

name: Comet Dial
description: Tick-ring dial you rotate, with a comet streaking behind the lit head.

name: Jelly Radio
description: Radio chips where the chosen one swells and nudges its neighbors.

name: Swipe Row
description: List row that swipes open to reveal actions and deletes on a full swipe.

name: Glide Select
description: Select chip whose menu pops from its corner with a gliding highlight.

name: Status Mark
description: Task status glyph morphing from idle ring to progress arc to check.

name: Call Chip
description: Tool-call chip with a wiping fill and timer, ending green or shaking red.

name: Bell Toggle
description: Pill toggle that rings a bell and crossfades its label.

name: Sling Button
description: Send button you pull back like a slingshot and release to fire.

name: Swipe Toast
description: Toast dismissed by swiping down, with a fuse showing time left.

name: Prompt Bar
description: Chat composer with mentions, slash commands, model picker, dictation and attachments.
tasteNote: Solid base for AI chat UIs; strip features you do not ship.

name: Slosh Gauge
description: Tank gauge whose liquid sloshes and splashes as the value changes.

name: Voice Pill
description: Mic button that swells into a capsule of live equalizer bars and a timer.

name: Thought Line
description: Reasoning trace header with a live clock that folds steps into one line.

name: Refine Frame
description: Media frame stepping an image through generation stages without layout shift.

name: Folder Float
description: Folder whose notes spring out into a floating cloud on hover or press.

name: Branched Menu
description: Collapsible menu branching sections off a trunk, tracing a line to your pick.

name: Flip Card
description: Two-sided card flipping in 3D on click, drag or flick.

name: Tear Ticket
description: Ticket with a perforated stub you tear off by hand.

name: Paper Crumple
description: Image crumples into a textured 3D sheet while held and dragged.

name: Shredder
description: List with a shredder at the bottom that cuts dragged rows into strips.

name: Flying Button
description: Button that fires thrusters on hover and lifts off on a smoke plume.
tasteNote: Launch-day gimmick; fine once, tiring as a permanent CTA.

name: Magic Card
description: Card with a spotlight gradient that tracks the cursor and lights its border.
tasteNote: Tasteful default for feature grids, especially on dark themes.

name: Android
description: Android phone frame mockup for app screenshots or video.

name: Warp Background
description: Container with a time-warp perspective grid of moving beams behind its content.

name: Line Shadow Text
description: Text with an animated diagonal-line shadow sliding behind it.

name: Aurora Text
description: Text filled with a slowly shifting aurora gradient.
tasteNote: Use on a key word inside the headline, not the whole line.

name: Morphing Text
description: Morphs between words with a gooey blurred crossfade.

name: Scroll Progress
description: Thin bar pinned to the top of the page tracking reading progress.
tasteNote: Useful on long articles; pointless on short landing pages.

name: Lens
description: Hover magnifier lens that zooms into images, video or any element.

name: Pointer
description: Replaces the cursor with a custom animated pointer inside a container.
Physics-based custom cursor that follows the mouse with spring easing.
tasteNote: Custom cursors suit portfolios; avoid in forms and apps.

name: Progressive Blur
description: Stacked blur layers that fade content at the edges of a scroll area.
tasteNote: Quietly premium for scroll containers and image captions.

name: Neon Gradient Card
description: Card wrapped in a glowing animated neon gradient border.
tasteNote: Loud; reserve for one featured plan or promo.

name: Noise Texture
description: SVG fractal noise overlay for subtle grain texture.
tasteNote: Low-opacity grain makes flat gradients feel printed.

name: Meteors
description: Diagonal meteor streaks falling across a container.

name: Grid Pattern
description: Customizable SVG grid-line background with optional highlighted squares.
tasteNote: Pair with a radial mask so the grid fades out; reliably tasteful.

name: Hexagon Pattern
description: SVG hexagon tile background pattern.

name: Striped Pattern
description: SVG diagonal stripe background pattern.

name: Interactive Grid Pattern
description: SVG grid whose squares highlight as the cursor passes over them.

name: Dot Pattern
description: SVG dot-matrix background, optionally glowing and animated.
tasteNote: Masked dot grid behind a hero is calm and modern.

name: Flickering Grid
description: Canvas grid of small squares flickering randomly in opacity.

name: Hero Video Dialog
description: Hero video thumbnail with play button that opens an animated video modal.
tasteNote: Clean way to put a product demo inside a hero.

name: Code Comparison
description: Side-by-side before and after code snippets with syntax highlighting.

name: Marquee
description: Infinite horizontal or vertical scroller for logos, testimonials or images.
tasteNote: The standard logo or testimonial rail; add edge fades and pause on hover.

name: Globe
description: Interactive auto-rotating WebGL globe with location markers.
tasteNote: Signals global reach; lazy load it when below the fold.

name: Glyph Matrix
description: Canvas grid of softly shifting glyphs in a theme-aware color.

name: Glare Hover
description: Diagonal glare sweeps across an element on hover, pure CSS.

name: Shimmer Button
description: Button with a shimmering light traveling around its border.
tasteNote: Use for one primary CTA, never a whole row of buttons.

name: Tweet Card
description: Embedded tweet card showing author, handle, avatar and text.

name: Client Tweet Card
description: Client-rendered variant of the tweet card for setups without server components.

name: Bento Grid
description: Bento layout of feature cards with icons, descriptions and hover call to action.
tasteNote: Strong feature-section skeleton; vary card sizes deliberately.

name: Particles
description: Canvas particle field that drifts and reacts to the mouse.

name: Number Ticker
description: Counts a number up or down to a target value when it enters view.
tasteNote: Best way to animate stat rows; keep the duration short.

name: Ripple
description: Concentric expanding rings that emphasize the element in front.

name: Retro Grid
description: Synthwave perspective grid scrolling toward the horizon.

name: Animated List
description: List revealing items one by one, like incoming notifications.

name: Animated Shiny Text
description: Light glare panning across text for a shimmering label.
tasteNote: Ideal for the small announcement pill above a hero headline.

name: Animated Grid Pattern
description: SVG grid with squares fading in and out at random.

name: Border Beam
description: A beam of light runs along a container's border.
tasteNote: Elegant on one featured card or input; use a slow duration.

name: Animated Beam
description: Light beams travel curved paths between elements, ideal for integration diagrams.
tasteNote: Best tool for an integrations section showing what connects to what.

name: Text Reveal
description: Words brighten from dim to full as you scroll through a paragraph.

name: Dia Text Reveal
description: A color band sweeps across text with a gradient shine, then settles.

name: Hyper Text
description: Scrambles letters before revealing the final word.

name: Animated Gradient Text
description: Text with an animated gradient cycling through colors.

name: Orbiting Circles
description: Icons orbiting along concentric circular paths around a center.

name: Dock
description: macOS-style dock with icon magnification on hover.

name: Word Rotate
